property_summary: For any non-zero, non-self contract_address and non-empty equal-length tos and vs arrays, transfer either returns true (no revert) or reverts before returning, and if it returns true then it must have returned true (idempotent) — i.e., successful calls always return true.
For any valid contract_address not zero or c and for single-element equal-length tos and vs arrays, if c.transfer does not revert then it returns true.
For any valid contract_address (non-zero, not c) and equal-length non-empty tos and vs, c.transfer either reverts or returns true; i.e., it cannot return false on successful call.
For any valid contract_address (non-zero, not c) and single-element equal-length non-empty tos and vs arrays, c.transfer either reverts or returns true (it never returns false on success).
For any valid contract_address (non-zero and not c) and non-empty equal-length tos and vs arrays, c.transfer either reverts or returns true (it never returns false).
